name: Frontend Core Pack
description: The shared frontend foundation: production-quality UI engineering, WCAG accessibility auditing, and browser/DevTools-based verification. Composed by the frontend and accessibility engineer packs; installable on its own for a minimal frontend baseline.
useCases: Give a coding agent the baseline frontend skills shared by UI and accessibility work: UI engineering, a11y auditing, and browser verification.
Start from a minimal frontend foundation and layer persona packs on top.
examplePrompts: Build this component to production quality and verify it in the browser, including keyboard and screen-reader behavior.
Audit this page against WCAG 2.2 AA and fix the violations you find.
